notes.title: New Update for Parabolus
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31769565/7ab00e4ed1b33bf7d369e3e076b4c40c584ea630.jpg[/img]

Hey guys! The 1.2 update for Parabolus has now been released.

[h1]Patch notes[/h1]

[b]New Game Mode[/b]
Treasure Hunt, Search the maze for treasure chests left behind from the golden age of spacetravel.

[b]New features[/b]

You can now hold down fire button to keep firing.
The right thumbstick now controls the camera.
There is now an option to show the direction arrow permanently.
Bullers are now bigger and faster.

notes.title: The 1.1 Update Is Here!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31769565/4a31b321d3cb3212565be2a9c865ae91edad667d.jpg[/img]
40 Pound Tiger is pleased to announce the 1.1 update for Parabolus.

The Dado Lacuna Corporation have asked Jimi for some help testing some new product lines. In return they have offered to improve the limited capabilities of his ship.

New features

[b]Graphical Updates[/b]
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31769565/8b4541d7d56813988f568b667eb7f9cdd5c94074.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31769565/438e4e21e95c393ea55e77eef6b8748e7b6f7eea.jpg[/img][/url]
This sci shooter now looks even better.

[b]Two new game modes[/b]

Planetule
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31769565/f70008931b4dd0251a52e6af3f58b281d8b5b8e3.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31769565/78a1d9dc0d73a75829c354a57745d0aa710f5908.jpg[/img][/url]
Just you and some rocks that need breaking up… Be careful though, they may smash into you.

Inverse Ninja Law
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31769565/1e21eb8dfad42184e3bc6b03e8455027ea30bef4.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31769565/4653b6aee3d9982f754cb9fc8cc192fd0f4db29d.jpg[/img][/url]
When play begins all the robots are slow and have little health but as you go through them they become tougher until the last one standing is a complete badass.

[b]Ship Improvements[/b]
The SRK-EMF Mining vessel has now been outfitted with a new shield system with can withstand laser fire. Along with small rocket boosters to allow the ship to barrel roll.

notes.title: Announcing a new update.
notes.content:
40 Pound Tiger is pleased to announce that the 1.1 update for Parabolus is coming soon.

The Dado Lacuna Corporation have asked Jimi for some help testing some new product lines. In return they have offered to improve the limited capabilities of his ship. 

[h1]New features[/h1]

[h1]Two new game modes[/h1]

[b]Planetule[/b]
Just you and some rocks that need breaking up…

[b]Inverse Ninja Law[/b]
When play begins all the robots are slow and have little health but as you go through them they become tougher until the last one standing is a complete badass.

[h1]Ship Improvements[/h1]
The SRK-EMF Mining vessel has now been outfitted with a new shield system with can withstand laser fire. Along with small rocket boosters to allow the ship to barrel roll.

notes.title: Well the time is nearly upon us...
notes.content:
Well the time is nearly upon us. 

Parabolus is going to be released on Friday after over three years of development. I can’t believe my game is finally going to be seen by the public. I am so proud of what I have been able to achieve and so excited to see other people playing something I created.

Game development encompasses a lot of things art, design, 3D modelling, programming, marketing, PR, testing and even script writing. It is small wonder that people started to team up as soon as games became more complex than dots on a screen. notes.title: Parabolus now on Linux!
notes.content: I am happy to announce that I have finally managed to figure out the relationship between the Linux and Unreal. That means that there is now a Linux version of the demo available from Steam.

notes.title: New Demo Released!
notes.content: A new demo of Parabolus is now up to celebrate Parabolus going Beta. Featuring NEW graphics, NEW bloom and NEW effects. But the SAME levels.

notes.title: Parabolus is now Beta!
notes.content: Just yesterday I finished the content for the last level. That means that Parabolus is now offically in beta. We got about a month of bug fixes to go yet but rest assured. You guys are in for a treat.
